words.def: responsible for managing or controlling something or someone.
words.book: He is being interviewed for an electronics engineer job by Rehab Osama, who is in charge of recruiting for the company, and two of her colleagues: Mazen, an engineering manager, and Mona, the new HR manager.
uses: Email
Eng. Hany is in charge of the maintenance contract for the hospital's UPS systems.
Chat
who's in charge of collections this month?
Meeting
I'll be in charge of the site installation; Sara will handle the paperwork.
dont: I am the responsible about the service team.
doo: I'm in charge of the service team.

words.ar: حد شاطر في تشخيص الأعطال وحلها
words.def: a person who finds and fixes the causes of technical or business problems.
words.book: I'm an effective troubleshooter and I like taking care of details, but I always keep an eye on the big picture — and it all comes down to end users and making sure they have a positive experience with the company.
uses: Email
Our field engineer troubleshot the inverter fault remotely and restored power within an hour.
Chat
can you troubleshoot the VFD alarm? client's line is down 🔧
Meeting
Mohamed is our best troubleshooter — send him to the data centre.
dont: I make the diagnosis of the problem and repair it.
doo: I troubleshoot and fix the fault.

words.def: the people who actually use a product or system, not those who buy or sell it.
words.book: The experience taught me more about how people use products, and it helped me put faces on the people who are our end users.
uses: Email
We'll provide training to the end users after the UPS installation.
Chat
is the reseller buying it or the end user?
Meeting
Let's think about the end users — the nurses need the power to never drop.
dont: The final people who use the device.
doo: The end users of the device.

words.def: companies or people that supply goods or services to another company.
words.book: Well, I could see myself in a supervisory role, coordinating with other test engineers, developers and vendors.
uses: Email
We are currently comparing three battery vendors on price and warranty.
Chat
the vendor still hasn't sent the spare parts 🙄
Meeting
Let's get quotations from at least two vendors before we decide.
dont: We will bring the parts from the sellers.
doo: We'll source the parts from our vendors.

words.def: to finish a meeting, task or discussion.
words.book: Well, I think it's time to start wrapping up.
uses: Email
Let's wrap up the site acceptance by Thursday so we can issue the invoice.
Chat
ok let's wrap up, I have a site visit at 3
Meeting
Before we wrap up, any questions about the new price list?

words.ar: يستغل / يستفيد من حاجة لأقصى درجة
words.def: to use something you have (skills, relationships, resources) to get the best result.
words.book: Now I'm looking to leverage everything I've learned in university and get some hands-on work experience.
uses: Email
We can leverage our existing contract with the bank to offer them solar solutions.
Chat
let's leverage the Schneider promo this month 💡
Meeting
We should leverage our service data to sell more battery replacements.
dont: We will make benefit from our relations.

upgrade.plain: Can I write while you are talking?
pro: Can I write while you are talking?
Do you mind if I take notes while we're speaking?
upgrade.why: ‎take notes‎ هي الكلمة الصح، و‎Do you mind if‎ مؤدبة.

upgrade.plain: I can give you also the customer service thing.
upgrade.ar: أقدر كمان أديكم موضوع خدمة العملا
pro: There's something else I can bring to the table: customer relations.
I can give you also the customer service thing.
upgrade.why: ‎bring to the table‎ يعني تقدّم ميزة إضافية.

upgrade.plain: I studied finance in the university.
pro: I studied finance in the university.
upgrade.why: ‎majored in‎ أدق لتخصصك، ومن غير ‎the‎ قبل ‎university‎.

upgrade.plain: I want to use what I studied in real work.
upgrade.ar: عايز أستخدم اللي درسته في شغل حقيقي
pro: I'm ready to put my knowledge into practice.
I want to use my study in real work.
upgrade.why: ‎put my knowledge into practice‎ عبارة جاهزة للمقابلات.

upgrade.plain: I see all the small details and the big thing also.
upgrade.ar: باخد بالي من التفاصيل الصغيرة والصورة الكبيرة كمان
pro: I see small and big things.
I see all the small details and the big thing also.
I pay attention to detail, but I always keep an eye on the big picture.

upgrade.plain: I was the one who must make it work with what we had.
upgrade.ar: كان عليا أنا أشغّلها باللي عندنا
pro: I was the one who must make it work.
It was up to me to adapt them to our needs.
It was on my head to fix it.
upgrade.why: ‎It was up to me‎ يعني المسؤولية كانت عليك.
